_comment: First delivery of an OrderCreated event — same envelope shape EventBridge actually delivers to OrderCreatedConsumerFunction (see events.function.OrderCreatedConsumerFunction's javadoc on why ScheduledEvent is the right input type despite the name). orderId is a placeholder; must not collide with an existing EVENT#<orderId> row in the deployed table or this stops being a 'first delivery' case. See order-created-consumer-duplicate.json for the redelivery counterpart.
